description: The model's ask taken (ADR-0010): under auto, in the author's phase, the first request_review of the run is answered with a note and recorded (the checkpoint's critic: mode auto, trigger model-asked); the run's proposal then has the trigger model-asked, so the decision runs the critic at the author's tier, before its critique and the proposal. A session with no cases, a new pack, the table's auto, tier off; not interactive, so no call ids. Written by hand; criticSwitch.test.ts holds the vercel engine's stream to it, and scenario 10 makes the same run on every engine and both Go adapters.
